name: mpocock
description: Matt Pocock's handoff and wayfinder skills: compact a conversation into a handoff document, and plan work too big for one session as a map of decision tickets.

interface.longDescription: handoff writes down what a session established, what it decided, and what is still open, in a form a fresh agent reads instead of the transcript. wayfinder charts work too big for one session as a shared map of decision tickets on the issue tracker, then resolves them one at a time. Both come from Matt Pocock's skills repository, https://github.com/mattpocock/skills, under MIT.
defaultPrompt: Write a handoff document for this session.
Wayfind this idea into a map of decision tickets.
